 Santiago & Romero Law Group
 Baytown, TX

04/06/2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1143 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our office represents Tanya Henson in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on 05/18/2023. On that day,
your insured changed lanes without checking that the adjacent lane was clear and sideswiped our client's vehicle, forcing it
against the guardrail and causing significant damage to the driver's side of the car. The police report documents the other driver's
admission that he did not see our client's vehicle before moving over.
As a result of the impact, our client suffered a lumbar back strain that has required ongoing medical treatment, including physical
therapy and prescribed pain management. Our client has missed substantial time from work and continues to experience stiffness,
limited range of motion, and pain when lifting or sitting for extended periods. Medical records and treatment notes supporting
thsee injuries are enclosed.
Liability in this matter is clear, and the damages are well documented. We therefore demand payment of $81,000.00 to resolve all
claims arising from this accident. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a
satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice and seek all damages available under the law,
including costs and interest.
Please direct all further communications regarding this claim to my office.
Expert review: Curtis James, biomechanical engineer
Sincerely,
James Cooke
Santiago & Romero Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
